payloads.value: docs/hardwood/data/<league>/<season>/value.json -> rows (cols incl. role, hpm, war, pct_role)

notes: fmt 'pct' values are 0-1 fractions in the payload (0.573 = 57.3 %).
scope 'pbp' metrics exist only in seasons with play-by-play (NBA 2002 on, WNBA 2003 on); treat as missing earlier.
style: true marks descriptive metrics (shot diet, pace): colour them neutrally, they are not better or worse.
WNBA HPM is almost entirely its box component (r(HPM, box impact) = 1.00 within role): WNBA RAPM carries little weight.

groups.peer_group: role G (players.json `role`, = value.json role): listed position G; compared within league and season

minimum.note: the payload's `qualified` flag: min >= players.json `min_floor` = round(0.2 x the season's most minutes); value is the typical full-season floor (NBA 510-700, WNBA 150-300), so it scales through a season

groups.basis: per 100 possessions on the floor and shooting / share rates; HPM per 100 possessions

metrics.explanation: Points per 100 possessions the player adds to the team's margin over an average player: play-by-play on/off blended with the box score.
The offensive half of HPM: points per 100 possessions added at the scoring end.
The defensive half of HPM: points per 100 possessions taken off opponents.
Points scored per 100 team possessions while on the floor.
Points per 100 possessions gained by shooting above the league's true-shooting rate on the player's volume.
Points above what an average shooter would score on the same shots (location and type), per 100 shots.
Share of team-mates' baskets assisted while on the floor.
Assists per turnover: creation against giveaways.
Free-throw attempts per 100 possessions: pressure on the rim and fouls drawn.
Share of opponent possessions ended by the player's steal while on the floor.
Points per shooting attempt, counting threes and free throws.
Share of team possessions the player finished with a shot, free throws or a turnover.
Field-goal percentage with threes worth 1.5 makes.
Share of three-point attempts made (slow to settle: needs hundreds of attempts).
Share of free throws made.
Free-throw attempts per field-goal attempt.
Share of shots taken from three: a style marker, not a skill score.
Share of made baskets that nobody assisted.
Assists per 100 possessions on the floor.
Turnovers per play used (shots, free-throw trips and turnovers).
Share of all available rebounds grabbed while on the floor.
Share of opponent two-point attempts blocked while on the floor.
Personal fouls per 100 possessions (fewer is better).
Regularised adjusted plus-minus: the play-by-play half of HPM on its own.
The box-score half of HPM: impact estimated from the stat line.
Team net rating with the player on the floor minus off it: noisy, needs several seasons.
Baskets made through contact, per 100 possessions.
Share of shots taken within 4 feet of the rim: a style marker.
Average shot distance: a style marker.

similar.standardise: z-score within league, role and season over qualified players
similar.weights_rule: yoy_r in this group, floored at 0.2
similar.distance: weighted euclidean over the features both player-seasons have (pbp-only features dropped pairwise before NBA 2002), divided by the square root of the summed weights
similar.constraints: same league and role, qualified player-seasons, any season, not the player's own seasons

view.why: Guards: assist rate against scoring efficiency added, coloured by total impact (HPM).

payload_changes.note: code and test done 22 Oct 2026 (value.classify_roles, identical to value.json role: 100% agreement on NBA 2026, WNBA 2026, NBA 2000); appears in the payloads at the next build; not rebuilt locally. Until then the role is in value.json rows (col 'role').

percentile within role among qualified players for players.ROLE_PCT_KEYS (35 keys: every headline and secondary metric here); about +7% on players.json (NBA 2026 3.76 MB -> 4.02 MB; ~10 MB over all seasons of both leagues).

the spec's similarity (role features, z within league-role-season, yoy-weighted euclidean, same role, k=5) as a new field beside the existing `similar` (which uses 20 league-percentile keys, all positions, RMS); front end switches to it once present.
payload_changes.done: 98995532 (similar_role on the spec recipe, and a per-player role_card); live after the next build

payload_changes.note: no measurement change needed in the payload; the spec measured them through an equivalent opponent-adjusted offence/defence fit on half-seasons (adj_off / adj_def). The rating path (log.net_rating_after) has net only.

impact.name: Impact model (HPM)
impact.about: Our plus-minus model: box score and play-by-play blended into points per 100 possessions above an average player, split into offence and defence.

rapm.name: RAPM
rapm.about: Regularised adjusted plus-minus from every stint, shrunk towards zero and towards last season.

war.name: Wins above replacement
war.about: Total impact turned into wins over a replacement-level player, given minutes.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Adjusted net, offensive and defensive ratings from our game model, opponent and venue adjusted.

wp.name: Win-probability model
wp.about: Our in-game chance of winning before and after every play; WPA adds up the swings while the player was involved.

shot.name: Shot-quality model
shot.about: Expected points per shot from location and shot type, fitted on league shots; shot-making is the points scored above it.
